info.title: svgc
info.description: An Svg drawing markup to C# code generator using SkiaSharp as rendering engine, optionally applying an expression recipe first.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Converts a svg file to a C# code.

options.name: inputFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to the input file

options.name: outputFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to the output file

options.name: projectFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to a project file describing a whole build

options.name: paintcode
options.description: The relative or absolute path to a PaintCode document to import, into a folder and project beside it

options.name: paintcodeIntegers
options.description: Write a whole-valued PaintCode number as an integer parameter. A guess: PaintCode has one numeric kind, so a continuous slider sitting on whole ends is retyped too [default: False]

options.name: recipeFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to a recipe applied to the input before generating

options.name: skiaSharp
options.description: The SkiaSharp major version the generated code is compiled against: 3 or 4

options.name: width
options.description: Resize the drawing to this width in pixels, keeping its aspect ratio

options.name: height
options.description: Resize the drawing to this height in pixels, keeping its aspect ratio

options.name: scale
options.description: Resize the drawing by this factor of the size it already has

options.name: padding
options.description: Space to leave around the drawing inside its size, as fractions of it: one, two, three or four values the CSS way, each 10% or 0.1

options.name: emit
options.description: What the output file receives: csharp, or svg for the document the recipe produced

options.name: singleFile
options.description: Emit every drawing of the batch into one C# file at this path

options.name: helperScope
options.description: Where shared helpers go in a single file: file (C# 11), internal, or perClass

options.name: cache
options.description: Keep the last picture Draw built and reuse it while the arguments are unchanged: none, lastValue or lastValueLocked

options.name: text-layout
options.description: What to do with text an expression drives: strict refuses it, baked writes the default in, relaxed draws it from the argument and gives up the layout rules that cannot follow a string

options.name: namespace
options.description: The generated C# namespace name

options.name: class
options.description: The generated C# class name

options.name: version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: help
options.description: Show help and usage information
